title: Make radio state and GPS continue screen-off
description: Rehome LocationProvider startup from MapScreen, persist channel state, implement local TTS/tone announcements, verify Android foreground-service behavior and screen-off PLI/TAK on XP5.
acceptance_criteria: Screen-off TAK receive/reconnect, fresh own PLI, XP5 knob channel switching and local announcement verified on actual device.

title: Implement channel state and XP5 input profile
description: Create app-owned presets and logical input layer with generic D-pad profile; capture actual XP5/knob/PTT events before assigning Sonim mappings. Include screen-off input delivery gate and held-PTT channel deferral.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests for relative/absolute selector, debounce/wrap and persistence; XP5 with display off changes channel by physical knob or documented blocking limitation.

title: Provision Android 36/JDK 17 toolchain and XP5 diagnostics
description: Local machine currently Java 26 without JDK 17, Android SDK or adb. Install/configure supported toolchain, connect XP5, record getprop/getevent/logcat model/build/knob/PTT sequences without secrets.
acceptance_criteria: Local assembleDebug/testDebugUnitTest pass and XP5 raw events are captured on and off screen.

title: Establish fork and document upstream boundaries
description: True GitHub fork, distinct app identity, technical assessment and reproducible build gate. Upstream pinned d1569ae; local machine lacks JDK 17 and Android SDK, CI validation needed.
acceptance_criteria: Fork parent verified, attribution retained, app label/id distinct, assessment captures TAK/map/location dependencies, build/test results recorded.
close_reason: Fork verified, identity/manifest assessment committed; JDK 17 CI assembleDebug and testDebugUnitTest passed (run 41890412060).

title: Remove map renderer and preserve TAK pipelines
description: Replace MapScreen/nav and remove MapLibre, Cesium, tile and map-only plugin dependencies incrementally. Preserve CoT, chat, contact, cert, GPS and PLI flows; audit UserPrefs/ConfigProfile persistence compatibility.
acceptance_criteria: Mapless APK compiles; MapLibre absent from runtime dependency graph; simulated TAK server sees inbound contacts and outbound PLI.

title: Replace UI and setup with button-only radio shell
description: Build radio home, channels, contacts, messages/canned replies, location/status/settings, and first-run manual/provisioned setup with deterministic focus and certificate import accessible without touch.
acceptance_criteria: Fresh-install navigation, setup and canned reply can complete using D-pad/Select/Back without touchscreen; include instrumentation tests.
